summary: COPEL (Energy Company of Parana) filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to divest its stake in Dona Francisca Energética S.A. (DFESA) to Gerdau S.A. The board also resolved not to exercise preemptive rights to acquire Celesc's shares in DFESA. Binding proposal from Gerdau is cited, motivated by high energy prices and self-generation benefits. The board approved the negotiation and signing of a Share Purchase Agreement. No financial terms (price, premium, close date) were disclosed in the filing. The decision was based on the proposal not meeting COPEL's profitability criteria. The transaction represents a strategic exit from a minority stake, with execution risk in the negotiation and regulatory steps.
